name: HORIZONTAL TUBE FURNACE
desc: High-Precision Horizontal Vacuum Atmosphere Tube Furnace workstation engineered for accurate high-temperature thermal treatments and anaerobic sintering operations. Features a high-purity quartz processing tube reaching a maximum heating temperature of 1200°C.
features: High-intensity thermal processing peak calibrated at exactly 1200°C
High-purity thermal shock resistant transparent Quartz Tube assembly
Low-thermal-mass high-efficiency structural Alumina Ceramic Fiber liners
Multi-segment memory block supporting a single program with 30 steps
Supplied complete with high-efficiency heavy-duty external mechanical Vacuum Pump

specifications.Equipment Configuration: High-Performance Smart Horizontal Vacuum Atmosphere Tube Furnace Station
specifications.Primary Process Function: High-uniformity small sample heating, sintering, and thermal profiling under gas purge
specifications.Maximum Hot-Zone Temperature: High-intensity thermal processing peak calibrated at exactly 1200 degrees C
specifications.Continuous Operational Heat: Continuous safe thermal operational workspace index rated at 1100 degrees C
specifications.Processing Tube Core Material: High-purity thermal shock resistant transparent Quartz Tube assembly
specifications.Standard Tube Outer Diameter: Precision structural layout footprint tracking a tube size of exactly 60 mm
specifications.Chamber Heating Zone Length: Continuous single-zone uniform heating span measuring exactly 350 mm
specifications.Thermal Monitoring Sensor: Industrial-grade integrated high-precision K Type structural thermocouple
specifications.Core Heating Element Matrix: Heavy-duty high-stability resistance wire elements with uniform surround wrapping
specifications.Chamber Insulation Architecture: Low-thermal-mass high-efficiency structural Alumina Ceramic Fiber liners
specifications.Primary System Controller: Advanced Programmable PID Temperature Controller with SCR power regulation
specifications.Process Program Profiling: Multi-segment memory block supporting a single program with 30 steps for Ramp and Dwell
specifications.Display Panel Architecture: High-contrast integrated dual LED screen displaying live Set Value and Process Value
specifications.Dynamic Thermal Ramp Speed: Controllable heating and cooling escalation scaling from 0 to 15 degrees C per minute
specifications.Anaerobic Processing Atmosphere: Fully optimized for inert atmosphere based heat treatments using Nitrogen or Argon
specifications.Primary Vacuum Auxiliary Kit: Supplied complete with high-efficiency heavy-duty external mechanical Vacuum Pump
specifications.Chamber Vacuum Capacity Index: Engineered to safely achieve initial vacuum negative drawdowns up to 0.1 MPa
specifications.Tube Sealing Hardware Kit: Pair of high-vacuum stainless steel matching sealing Flanges with secure O rings
specifications.Thermal Equilibrium Safeguards: Supplied complete with 1 pair of high-density Alumina Ceramic End Plugs for tube edges
specifications.Chamber Connection Piping: High-durability temperature-stable flexible Silicone Tube assembly loops
specifications.Electrical Power Inputs: Standard 220 Volts AC, 50 Hz, Single Phase stable Indian plug mains connection
specifications.Target Field Applications: Nanotechnology, Thin Film Deposition, Chemical Vapor Diffusion, and Wafer Sintering
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive On-site Manufacturer Warranty on core PID logic and elements
